verdict.rationale: The plugin docs say `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previews changes and a second command 'writes the selected skill files', which hints at selective installation. However, the hands-on dry run shows only a single `ultrametric/SKILL.md` written to two harness targets (Codex and Claude Code), so the selection appears to be by harness, not by picking skills from a multi-skill collection. missing for 10: evidence of a multi-skill collection, a documented way to choose individual skills, and hands-on confirmation of a per-skill install.
